description: Check and interpret data-breach exposure for an email, username, phone or name using Have I Been Pwned, the Pwned Passwords k-anonymity range API, DeHashed, IntelX and Snusbase. Use when checking breach or leak exposure, finding which services an account was registered with, interpreting a combolist or credential dump, assessing credential compromise, or auditing your own leaked personal data. Applies to incident response and account-takeover triage, executive and VIP protection, pre-employment and vendor risk screening, and personal privacy audits. Reference at useosint.com/skills/what-leaked-about-you.
